scope: Google guidance plus explicitly identified InspectMesh engineering policies. Runtime reports state measured scope and unknown evidence.

rules.acceptance: Every finite public router route is explicitly classified; no unknown routes/expressions silently omitted
Every indexable page has the correct generated document and stable page identity; a homepage fallback with rewritten title/canonical fails
Canonical indexable pages return 200 HTML to a fresh GET. HEAD may supplement, never replace GET
Genuine missing page/asset returns 404/410; no success-code homepage/error fallback, including nested detail families
Redirect destinations are explicit, loop-free and preserve intended path/query; indexable internal links and sitemap avoid redirects
rules.severity: ERROR for wrong/looping target; WARN for an extra successful hop

rules.acceptance: Routes and assets are served from one coherent release; required built outputs/chunks exist; stale/missing prerender artifacts fail
Deployment audit is tied to the exact source/artifact hash; a prior unrelated green result cannot certify a new upload
robots.txt is reachable, parses and allows intended page crawling for the applicable Googlebot groups
rules.severity: ERROR if blocked; UNKNOWN on unresolved transient network failure

rules.acceptance: Parse all applicable meta and X-Robots-Tag directives, including agent-scoped values and restrictive combinations; intended index pages have no effective noindex
Initial and rendered directives match route intent; do not rely on JS to remove an initial noindex
Scripts/CSS and assets needed for crawlable page content are not blocked or denied; a challenge/login wall is not a normal page response
Intentional noindex pages remain crawlable when Google needs to see noindex; robots blocking is not a substitute for noindex [G7]
Preview/staging controls are explicit. A noindex header must never leak into production; private environments require actual access control
InspectMesh indexable HTML emits one absolute HTTPS canonical to the intended production path; its target is a canonical 200 page
HTTP Link canonicals, HTML canonicals, redirects and sitemap do not conflict; hydration does not replace the correct source canonical [G3]
Known preset/tracking variants retain useful behavior and canonicalize according to declared query policy; do not blanket-strip unknown content-changing parameters
Preserve path case, encoded slash identity and meaningful queries during comparison. Fragment removal for document identity is separate from fragment target checking
Do not canonicalize all tools/guides to hubs or home; related topics with distinct content keep their legitimate routes
No unsupported geography/language targeting: English content stays English. Validate reciprocal hreflang only if genuine alternate language/region pages exist
rules.severity: N/A now unless actual alternates are discovered

rules.acceptance: Parse XML and sitemap indexes with a real parser; recursively fetch permitted sitemap children with cycle/count/size limits
Expected sitemap set equals the independently classified `sitemap: true` route set; no duplicates, unsupported host, fragments or unintended query states
Sitemap URLs return canonical indexable 200 content, not redirects/noindex/error documents
Valid lastmod, not future-dated; preserve dates for unchanged pages; significant changes have traceable dates
rules.severity: ERROR for invalid/future date; WARN for unverified change provenance

rules.acceptance: Sitemap declaration and generated output agree; XML escaping, limits and expected files are correct
Public landing pages ship expected title, canonical, main heading, useful page-specific text and crawlable links in initial HTML; tools need no upload for that content
Correct HTML head structure, charset and usable main landmark; metadata isn't misplaced or duplicated by competing services
rules.severity: ERROR for broken parser-visible identity; WARN for noncritical markup

rules.acceptance: Hydration retains page identity, important text, canonical/directives and links; direct load and client navigation both work
Initial/rendered critical text is not replaced by blank/error/loading-only content on timeouts, blocked third-party scripts, local-storage absence or first visit
Mobile has the same important content/indexing signals/links; no need to click, scroll or accept cookies to load core indexable text [G8]
Test viewport/legibility, menus, uploads/forms and constrained horizontal scrolling; wide tables may scroll inside their own container
rules.severity: ERROR for unusable page-level overflow; WARN for lesser issues

rules.acceptance: First-party JS errors or blocked first-party requests that break content/navigation fail; unrelated third-party noise is separately classified
Use real `<a href>` navigation for discoverable pages; disabled/button-only routing cannot be the only path [G5]
Resolve relative links and assets using the effective document base, including `<base href>`; respect URL semantics
Every required public page is reachable in the site graph; report chrome, hub and contextual inlinks separately
rules.severity: ERROR for orphan; WARN for depth beyond local target

rules.acceptance: Internal page/download links reach expected resource types; a 200 HTML error response in place of STL/JS/CSS does not pass
Fragment targets exist uniquely in the actual target document; verify both copied URL behavior and real browser clicks for shared jump navigation
Route construction uses existing project constants/helpers. Do not introduce repeated hardcoded route strings or parallel route maps
Broken external links have bounded checks and reviewable evidence; rate limits/challenges/network failures do not become permanent SEO failures
Nonempty accurate page-specific title; exact duplicates across intended distinct search pages reported
rules.severity: ERROR under local policy; allow narrow justified exceptions

rules.acceptance: Nonempty useful description; duplicate/missing descriptions reported; no arbitrary length failure
rules.severity: WARN except missing required content data in local schema

rules.acceptance: One meaningful H1 is the local template policy; sensible headings, language and viewport
rules.severity: ERROR for template-policy break; not labelled a Google indexing prerequisite

rules.acceptance: No placeholder output, template tokens, empty main, wrong page identity or exact main-content clones disguised by a new canonical
Near-duplicate topics/text are surfaced for review with boilerplate excluded; no automatic word-count padding, redirect, deletion or noindex
Parse every JSON-LD block and graph, including arrays; verify emitted type-specific required properties and consistent IDs/URLs
Article/Breadcrumb/other emitted data matches visible page identity, claims and dates; breadcrumb order/URLs and visible trail agree
Missing recommended Article properties produce actionable warnings; only actual supported, relevant images/authors are added
Retired/irrelevant rich-result features do not become requirements; no invented ratings, Product offers, reviews or FAQ promises [G10, G11]
rules.severity: WARN for obsolete policy; ERROR for fabricated claims

rules.acceptance: Informative images have appropriate alt text and load successfully; decorative images may use empty alt [G13]
rules.severity: ERROR for missing required assets; WARN for editorial alt issues

rules.acceptance: Image/media space is reserved by dimensions or equivalent CSS; below-fold lazy loading is appropriate; likely LCP media is not indiscriminately deferred
Field targets: p75 LCP ≤2.5 s, INP ≤200 ms, CLS ≤0.1; record mobile/desktop, window, URL/group and sample availability [G14]
rules.severity: WARN or UNKNOWN; field data is not an every-commit gate

rules.acceptance: Controlled lab runs use pinned tools/environment, repeatable throttling and representative templates; compare before/after budget evidence
rules.severity: WARN initially; gate only a justified stable regression budget

rules.acceptance: Check eligible compression, intentional Cache-Control, ETag/Last-Modified and deployment consistency; hashed assets do not silently change bytes at the same URL
rules.severity: WARN for optimizations; ERROR for stale/broken-release behavior

rules.acceptance: HTTPS/certificates and critical mixed-content behavior work for production and known redirect hosts
Required HTML stays available under a first visit and missing optional APIs; no indexing dependency on CAPTCHA, consent completion, upload or WebGL

Current initial-HTML routes stay reachable, all guides remain in their unfiltered index, format tools link through their hubs, priority pages retain real contextual inbound links, visible breadcrumbs match JSON-LD, and explicitly retired paths have no current artifacts or links. These are project quality targets, not Google ranking thresholds.
